newsitem.title: USA: Natl Re holders to get 0.37 General Re/shr.
newsitem.headline: Natl Re holders to get 0.37 General Re/shr.

text.p: General Re Corp said on Wednesday each National Re shareholder would receive 0.37262 of a share of General Re common stock for each share exchanged, following the merger.

The company said in a statement that, as previously announced, each former shareholder entitled to receive cash consideration would receive $53 in cash, without interest, for each National Re share surrendered.
National Re said on Tuesday holders of less than 50 percent of the company's outstanding shares elected to receive cash in connection with the merger.
Under the merger terms, at least 50 percent of the deal had to be done in stock for the merger to be tax free.

General Re, the largest professional reinsurer in the United States, said the conversion ratio was determined by dividing $53 by the average closing price of General Re common stock for the 10 consecutive trading days from September 18 up to and including October 1.
The merger was expected to be completed on October 3.
